Polar: Turn Your Software into a Business - Polar

name: Polar
summary: Billing platform for developers: payments, subscriptions and usage-based billing as a merchant of record.
description: Polar is a Merchant of Record for software and AI companies: it handles payments, sales tax, fraud, refunds and payouts. Products combine usage billing from ingested events, subscriptions with trials and proration, credits, seat-based pricing and automated benefits such as license keys, GitHub access and Discord roles. Aimed at developers and small teams selling digital products.
contains: usage billing, subscriptions and credits composable on one product
hosted, embedded and API checkout with localization
merchant of record in over 100 markets: tax, fraud, refunds and chargebacks
automated benefits: Discord roles, GitHub repo access, file downloads and license keys
event ingestion strategies for LLM, S3 and stream usage
pricing: free Starter; Pro $20/mo, Growth $100/mo, Scale $400/mo
startup program: Scale plan free for 12 months
